HPI @SIGGRAPH 2021

The SIGGRAPH 2021 starts next week. We are very honored to present three publications during the Appy Hour: 

  • MotionViz: Artistic Visualization of Human Motion on Mobile Devices (link to venue)
  • StyleTune: Interactive Style Transfer Enhancement on Mobile Devices (link to venue)
  • Forward Selfies (link to venue)

We are even more honored to have been featured in the offical SIGGRAPH teaser. We are looking forward to see all the breakthrough research of the worlds biggest computer graphics conference!
